name: Essence Extraction
notes: In game (hwp_wlk_essence_extraction, tested, run 20261021-232748): a hit by a magic weapon is an Essence gain, once per the cooldown. Magic weapons = every arcane-tagged weapon: staff, wand, tome, and the Holy DLC scepter and lantern (assumed reading; any class can equip them). Drain Essence's own melee gain stays. "Effects trigger twice" is read as: a gain from a Pyrebranded enemy counts twice (two stacks, and Drain Essence's bleed, health and mana twice), for the magic and the melee gain alike (assumed). The old +max Essence and the melee-on-branded-elites gain are gone; the max is the vanilla 10. Not measured: the scepter and lantern (Holy DLC gear does not generate in the lab) and the off hand (the tome's glyph lands at the warlock's feet).
summary: Magic weapon attacks now also count towards gaining stacks of Essence, with 2 second cooldown. Essence stacks gained from branded enemies have their effects trigger twice.
